DAG = {
    "ingest": [],
    "validate": ["ingest"],
    "profile": ["ingest"],
    "train": ["validate"],
    "evaluate": ["train"],
    "deploy": ["evaluate"],
}

def topo_order(dag):
    done = set()
    order = []
    while len(order) < len(dag):
        ready = sorted(t for t in dag if t not in done and all(d in done for d in dag[t]))
        if not ready:
            raise ValueError("cycle detected")
        task = ready[0]
        done.add(task)
        order.append(task)
    return order

order = topo_order(DAG)
for i, task in enumerate(order, 1):
    print(f"step {i}: {task}")
print(f"pipeline complete: {len(order)} tasks")
